thread:
mike: starting a canary comparison between v12 and v12-quant on canary-7. looking at token-level latency breakouts and kernel selection ratios. dashboards: https://go/redwood/dash/rollout/miX :eyes:
anya: saw a ~6% p95 lift on route /chat-stream for the canary, but p50 is basically unchanged. suspect batching boundary shifts.
devon: can you dump kernel usage? i want counts for continuous vs batched kernels over the run window.
mike: pasted quick profile snippet from the run:
```text
kernel_choice: {continuous: 62%, batched_kernel_v2: 35%, fallback: 3%}
kv_hit_rate: 78%
batch_size_median: 4
```
sasha: kv hit looks low for that route. are prefixes getting evicted mid-request? what's the kv TTL / shard sizing on canary hosts?
anya: TTL is default 5m. canary nodes happened to get smaller kv-shard mem after the quant change; eviction rate up ~12% in the kernel logs.
devon: that fits. the batching heuristic we shipped in v12-quant raised max_group_time to 12ms to improve throughput; that increases batch assembly time and can push p95 up for short prompts.
mike: repro steps i used: run 1000 short prompts (avg tokens 12) on canary-7 vs stable. perf summary (token-level):
```text
stable p95 token-latency: 48ms
canary p95 token-latency: 51ms
tokenization-overhead: +1.2ms
kv-miss penalty median: +3.4ms
```
ops: @infra-bot started a routing test job id: job-8943. link: https://go/redwood/jobs/8943 :rocket:  
infra-bot: job-8943: 1000 requests sent, 4 workers, collection complete. summary uploaded to https://s3.redwood/infra/jobs/8943/summary.json 
sasha: propose quick mitigations: 1) reduce max_group_time to 8ms on canary, 2) bump kv cache size on canary hosts, 3) add kernel-fallback logging to capture continuous->batched transitions.
anya: +1. I'll open a rollout patch for the canary config with those changes and add per-route SLO alerts for token-latency regression >3%.
mike: after the config flip let's re-run job-8943 and compare the job summaries + the per-route KPI dashboards: https://go/redwood/dash/compare?job=8943
devon: also add a tiny tracing hook to emit a per-token span tag kernel=batched|continuous so we can correlate kernel-choice with observed token slowdown in traces.
sasha: good call. tagging this thread for the perf review meeting tomorrow 10:30am PT. :calendar:
mike: final note: keep canary traffic at 10% until we validate. i'll post updated numbers and the final A/B delta here once we re-run.
